scenarios.name: bounded implementation
scenarios.input_task: Implement the smallest repository change and add tests for the failing behavior.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Read target files, patch narrowly, run focused checks, and report changed files and proof class.
scenarios.completion_report: Changed files, behavior fixed, tests run, skipped checks, and claim boundary.

scenarios.name: architecture decision
scenarios.input_task: Choose the repository migration strategy before editing code.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Compare options, select a route, define fallback and verification path.
scenarios.completion_report: Decision, selected route, rejected alternatives, verification plan, and remaining risk.

scenarios.name: official Codex docs check
scenarios.input_task: Check the latest official Codex AGENTS.md and skills docs before updating the runtime guide.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Retrieve official OpenAI sources, synthesize with citations, and hand off implementation if needed.
scenarios.completion_report: Source-backed summary, source ledger, freshness note, limitations, and implementation handoff.

scenarios.name: release claim review
scenarios.input_task: Decide whether this Codex runtime package can be called skill-discovery-confirmed based only on static file validation.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Inspect available evidence, compare to runtime-discovery requirements, downgrade unsupported claims, and issue a hold verdict.
scenarios.completion_report: Verdict, evidence inspected, missing Codex runtime output, blocked claims, and next required run.

scenarios.name: Codex harness asset creation
scenarios.input_task: Create Codex runtime validation fixtures and artifact map entries without changing Gemini source assets.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Identify subsystem and owner layer, create the smallest Codex runtime artifact, validate non-mirror and claim boundary.
scenarios.completion_report: Changed artifact, subsystem, owner layer, validation path, claim boundary, and remaining risk.

scenarios.name: Codex subagent coordination
scenarios.input_task: Coordinate separate official-doc research, implementation, and review agents for a Codex migration.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Check single-agent sufficiency, assign ownership, define join contract, track lifecycle, integrate and verify.
scenarios.completion_report: Topology, roles, lifecycle state, join result, unresolved gaps, and validation owner.
